long_biography.plain_text:
Ömer Mehmet Koç, chair of Koç Holding, helped create Arter as a platform for contemporary art. Working through the Vehbi Koç Foundation, he supported production and exhibitions before chairing the centre's board. His Ancient Greek degree, completed before an MBA, supplied an unusual academic foundation for that cultural work.

Koç's collecting ranges across Ottoman books, photography and İznik ceramics as well as contemporary art. Exhibitions and scholarly catalogues have made portions of those private holdings publicly accessible. He also chairs the Turkish Education Foundation's board of trustees, helping direct an organisation founded to provide scholarships and widen educational opportunity.
